NETWORK HELPER — COMPANION SOURCE DOWNLOAD

File: RetroWeather_v1.2.1_Network_Source.zip
Publish this file alongside EVERY download of RetroWeather_Setup_v1.2.1.exe,
with equal public access and no charge. Keep it accessible while distributing
this binary; do not rely solely on a link to a moving upstream repository.
The source pack is included in the full Public Release Pack's release folder.

Contents:
- curl-build-win32/, exact upstream recipe at commit 48b4085, including patches.
- packages/, complete exact tarballs from dependencies.lst,
  plus the recipe certificate bundle. All listed SHA256 digests verified.
- prepare-cache.py: verifies the readable tarballs and fills the upstream cache.
- shipped-ca-bundle.crt: exact data from the binary distribution.
- PROVENANCE.json and SHA256SUMS.txt.
- NETWORK_BUILD.txt, explains the upstream MSYS2/WinLibs build environment.
No dependency source has been edited. Sources for the upstream full build are
included too, so the original recipe can run unchanged even though the shipped
binary is the smaller slim variant. Third-party copyrights/licenses remain in
those archives. General-purpose build tools are acquired separately.

The bundled binary matches upstream's curl-8.20.0-win-x86-slim.2026-05-02.zip.
https://github.com/lordmulder/cURL-build-win32/releases/tag/2026-05-03
https://github.com/lordmulder/cURL-build-win32/tree/48b4085

Build on a modern Windows development machine, not XP. Follow the included
upstream README.md; enter the MSYS2 MINGW32 shell, configure a suitable MSVCRT
WinLibs i686 compiler, run python3 prepare-cache.py from the source pack root, then enter
curl-build-win32 and run ./build.sh. The recipe builds full and slim
variants; use the x86 slim output. Preserve the XP target/legacy-CPU guidance.
Upstream sources, patches and package checksums are pinned. Exact byte-for-byte
reproduction with an arbitrary newer compiler is not claimed; this session
verified provenance, not a full independent rebuild of the third-party helper.

The MIT player uses the helper as a separate executable. Its own complete source
and build_windows.cmd are in RetroWeather_v1.2.1_Source.zip / the public repository.
